_comment: Tier-2 for febio::rigid_body#6. A rigid body rotated 0.5 rad about x: omitting <center_of_mass> pivots it about its own geometric centre; writing <center_of_mass>0,0,5</center_of_mass> pivots it about that point and moves the body a long way; adding <override_com>1</override_com> gives a BIT-IDENTICAL result to the previous run, so the companion flag is neither needed nor effective. All three reach normal termination with exit 0 — the only detection is reading node positions back out. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
